subject: [PATCH 1/2] perf/x86/amd/uncore: Remove redundant event slot scan

reviews.author: tip-bot2 for Usama Arif
reviews.summary: The patch has been merged into the perf/core branch of tip.

2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch removes a redundant event slot scan in the perf/x86/amd/uncore code, improving performance by reducing unnecessary pointer traversals. The change is motivated by the observation that events are serialized and their indices are recorded during initialization, making it possible to directly check for existing assignments without scanning all counters.
